_doc: Quiet growth on every level-up (scripts/match/level_growth.gd). Each level a hunter reaches adds hp (a share of the class's base health) and ap (ability power: a multiplier on ability damage, and on healing and shields from abilities). Levels 2-6 use the full rate; levels 7-10 use half_from's half rate. Nothing pops up for it: the level badge flashes and its tooltip shows the totals. xp: what each source gives toward the next run level (LevelGrowth.xp; the level table XP_TO and the ranks stay in scripts/match/hunter.gd): trickle_per_s while on the ground and up, per_dmg_hunter / per_dmg_monster for each point of damage dealt, knock for knocking a rival Hunter down, lair_boss to the killer's squad at a lair boss (half or a fifth to other squads that fought it). Paced in docs/LEVEL_PACE.md.
